summary: Comprehensive testing of GST Rules Engine for Kairos AI ERP. All 43 backend tests passed (100%). 1 test skipped (Motherson Sumi vendor not in seeded data). GST rules engine fully functional with CGST+SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state, CGST+UTGST for UTs without legislature.
test_credentials: No authentication required - all endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: Created 2 POs during testing (INEOS India for IGST test, LANXESS India for CGST+SGST test). Created 1 SO for inter-state customer IGST test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GST Rules Engine fully tested and working. All 36 Indian states/UTs configured with correct GST codes. Tax computation working for: intra-state (CGST+SGST), inter-state (IGST), intra-UT with UTGST (Chandigarh, Ladakh, etc.), intra-UT with SGST (Delhi, Puducherry, J&K). HSN/SAC validation working. PO and SO integration with GST rules working correctly.

gst_states_api.details: GET /api/gst/states returns all 36 states/UTs with code, name, alpha, is_ut, utgst, tax_regime fields

gst_state_resolution.details: GET /api/gst/state/{state} resolves by GST code (27), name (Maharashtra), alpha code (MH), lowercase

gst_compute_tax_intra_state.details: POST /api/gst/compute-tax: Maharashtra->Maharashtra returns CGST+SGST (9%+9% for 18% rate)

gst_compute_tax_ut_sgst.details: POST /api/gst/compute-tax: Delhi->Delhi returns CGST+SGST (UT with legislature)

gst_compute_line_items.details: POST /api/gst/compute-line-items: Multi-item tax computation with different HSN/rates working

gst_validate_hsn.details: POST /api/gst/validate-hsn: Validates HSN (2-8 digit goods) and SAC (99xx services) codes

po_gst_integration_igst.details: POST /api/purchase/orders: PO with Gujarat vendor (INEOS India) from Maharashtra company -> IGST in tax_breakdown

po_gst_integration_cgst_sgst.details: POST /api/purchase/orders: PO with Maharashtra vendor (LANXESS India) from Maharashtra company -> CGST+SGST in tax_breakdown

so_gst_integration.details: POST /api/selling/sales-orders: SO with inter-state customer -> IGST in tax_breakdown

items_hsn_gst_fields.details: Items have hsn_sac and gst_rate fields. RM-BPA=2907, RM-MDI=2929, EP-1000=3907

entities_gst_state_code.details: Entities with Indian GSTIN have gst_state_code and state fields. INEOS=Gujarat(24), LANXESS=Maharashtra(27)

uts_with_utgst: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu(26)
